charter: Implement POST /api/login, GET /api/me, POST /api/events/:eventId/registrations. Use exactly one session transport. Shared interfaces: auth.session, auth.server, events.registration.

vocabulary.description: How login establishes a session and how /api/me reads it (client transport).
The helper other routes call to get the current user; name and signature.
POST registration request/response/errors the UI relies on.

items.text: The UI posts to /api/events/evt-1/registrations and shows 'Registered' on 201 or 'Already registered' on 409; needs the response shape {id,eventId,userId}.
UI relies on auth.session for the logged-in user before registering.

findings.explanation: codex's UI requires events.registration but no participant produces it (droid's plan is missing). This requirement is unowned; someone must own POST /api/events/:eventId/registrations.
